lineAttribution.supports: The file describes a modern C# translation and naming/interface substitutions, not original-binary equivalence.
The source deck size is 18 and backing hand limit is 7. This kernel does not accept or consume a deck.
Living-person capacity outcomes 4,5,6,7 motivate the bounded active-hand checkpoint. The caller resolves person, alive state and capacity; these are not executed here.
CharacterGetPersonality may resolve an override or person fallback. The kernel takes the resolved personality string and runs neither lookup.

Timer-setting, decrement and reset are source context only. The admitted integer range 0..4 is an explicit engine checkpoint policy, not a claim that all possible source states are reachable or bounded this way.

Surrounding helper context: CharacterSortCards sorts the active numeric prefix; CharacterFillCards restores reserved 0, fills, conditionally repairs a topic, then sorts. CharacterSetCard is outside this kernel. No helper in this range is invoked.
Numeric Array.Sort over active slots supports final card-face order, not equal-card physical identity ordering.

Checkpoint provenance only: fill sets slot 0 to Rethink, fills remaining slots, ensures a topic when a new slot exists, then sorts. This standalone component requires the resulting checkpoint but does not clear, fill, regenerate, consume deck data or repair.
CharacterRethink source context contains excluded clearing/refill followed by the selected bonus and final sort.
Excluded prefix: clear each active slot and call CharacterFillCards. The input is after this prefix and its internal sort.
Positive anger timer is checked before personality; only Calm reaches RandBool(40). Exactly one supplied boolean call result is required iff these gates pass.

RandBool(40) precedes topic range checking. Both true and false supplied results are consumed for any signed-32 topic when the timer/personality gate passes; no integer-to-bool mapping or probability proof is established.

True plus topic 0,1,2 assigns Story3,Logic3,Trend3 respectively to physical slot 1, even when the card face is unchanged. It does not search for a preferred topic or overwrite a final sorted position.
Final sorting is unconditional, including zero timer, non-Calm, false result, invalid topic and same-face overwrite.
Translation and inferred-enum disclosure limits the evidence level.
Rethink=0; topic cards=1..9; Story3=3,Logic3=6,Trend3=9; rhetoric cards=10..14.
Topic Story,Logic,Trend map to 0,1,2; Topic_Max=3. This enum group is described as inferred from implementation.
The four personality faces are Timid,Calm,Bold,Reckless; only Calm takes the selected bonus branch.

contract.policyComparison: Exact complete canonical policy structure, not id-only matching.
contract.checkpoint: Already-filled and numerically sorted active hand of length 4..7; first card exactly 0, remaining cards integer 1..14, at least one ordinary topic card 1..9. No empty slot or second reserved 0 is admitted.
contract.currentTopic: Signed 32-bit integer. Out-of-game-range integers outside 0..2 are admitted no-replacement topics, not invalid input.
contract.rawResults: Required dense array containing exactly one closed object {role: debate-calm-rethink-rand-bool, percent: 40, value: boolean} iff angerTimer > 0 and personality is calm; otherwise empty. The value is an already-resolved call result, never a numeric RNG draw.
contract.failureSemantics: Atomic typed failure with no partial hand, policy, evidence or audit; the input is neither mutated nor frozen.
contract.fractionalNumbers: Rejected as malformed-data during safe detachment, before individual field ranges are parsed.
contract.auditInputHand: The original supplied already-sorted checkpoint before optional overwrite.
contract.auditBooleanResult: Null when gated off; otherwise index 0 plus the exact role, percent and boolean, including invalid-topic cases.
contract.auditReplacement: Null unless assignment occurs; sourceSlot always 1, before is the original slot-1 face, after is 3/6/9. Same-face assignment remains replacement-applied with changed=false.
contract.auditSortBefore: After any replacement, immediately before the unconditional final sort; this is not the original inputHand when an actual face change occurs.
contract.auditSourceIndices: At each final output position, the corresponding physical slot in audit.sort.before. This is not final-position-to-original-card-identity provenance through refill.
contract.equalCardIdentity: Equal faces use pre-final-sort physical slot ascending only for deterministic engine audit. No native Array.Sort equal-card identity guarantee is claimed.

admissionNotSourceReachability: sorted and complete hand with exactly one reserved 0 and at least one ordinary topic
